subject: featureCounts report zero read count even with -O flag

messages.author: 00d4ba56c26a209d
messages.subject: featureCounts report zero read count even with -O flag
parts:
Hello,


I am running featureCounts on a set of paired end reads. I used STAR to map the reads to a reference genome, and see that about 90% are mapped.


I use featureCounts (v1.5.3) with this command:

featureCounts -p -B -O -M --primary -t CDS -g gene_id -a LS_geneid.gtf -o counts_test.txt AE_processed_July26Aligned.out.sam

There are ~22,000 genes listed in the GTF file. I see that ~18,000 genes are listed in the output, and about 3,500 of them have a read count of 0. How does this happen? I saw a similar post here and included the -O flag, but the zeros have not gone away.

Thank you very much!

Nancy

Hi Nancy,

The counting results seem normal to me.

Not all genes will receive counts. Most of your unassigned reads are due to not overlapping with any genes.

Cheers,

Wei

messages.subject: Re: featureCounts report zero read count even with -O flag

Hello Wei,

But the issue is that I know that not all genes in the gtf file are in the results file. So I see that about 80% of my total number of genes are in the results file, and of that 80%, some genes received a read count of 0. Do you know of any reason where this can happen?

Thank you very much,

Nancy

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts report zero read count even with -O flag
parts: The genes I referred to are those that are included in the counting results. The reason that some genes have zero counts could be that they do not express at all or your sequencing depth is not deep enough to detect them. There might be other reasons as well.
